name: Octahedral Surface Texture
aliases: Paired Octahedral Surface and View-Dependent Textures
definition: A per-cell appearance representation replacing spherical harmonics, using an 8x8 RGB texture projected onto the cell surface to allow spatial appearance variation within one view.
summary: Octahedral Surface Texture is a per-cell appearance representation using an 8x8 RGB texture mapped via octahedral projection, which reduces memory usage and eliminates singularities compared to spherical harmonics.
